7 months ago, AOC and I introduced an AI data center moratorium.

Last night, 43 of 44 communities voted for one locally.

Americans don’t want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment, gutting jobs and threatening humanity’s future.

NATIONAL DATA CENTER MORATORIUM NOW
